name: Nutty Chicken Curry
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical 4 chicken breasts + sauce volume for 4 adult portions
Total time is sum of active prep (~5-7 min) and cook steps (1+1+10 min) rounded to nearest 5; excludes rice/sweet potato
Peanut butter classified as containing peanuts (true) and conservatively as possible tree-nut cross-contact (null)
Greek yogurt classified as containing milk (true); unspecified if it contains live cultures or additives
Chicken stock assumed to be a prepared liquid with no wheat/soy (null for those allergens)
No wheat, barley, rye or oats listed so Gluten-free = true
Coriander, chilli, ginger, garlic, oil are plant-based and compatible with all listed diets where not blocked by other ingredients
instructions:
Finely slice a quarter of the chilli, then put the rest in a food processor with the ginger, garlic, coriander stalks and one-third of the leaves. Whizz to a rough paste with a splash of water if needed.
Heat the oil in a frying pan, then quickly brown the chicken chunks for 1 min. Stir in the paste for another min, then add the peanut butter, stock and yogurt. When the sauce is gently bubbling, cook for 10 mins until the chicken is just cooked through and sauce thickened. Stir in most of the remaining coriander, then scatter the rest on top with the chilli, if using. Eat with rice or mashed sweet potato.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large red chili ≈45g whole; edible portion after trimming stem.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: 0.5 inch / 15g fresh ginger root, peeled weight.

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: Bunch of fresh coriander ≈25g usable leaves and stalks combined (typical small bunch trimmed).

ingredients.name: Chicken Breasts
ingredients.assumptions: 4 typical skinless chicken breasts, raw edible weight ≈600g total (150g each).

ingredients.name: Peanut Butter
ingredients.assumptions: 5 tbsp smooth peanut butter ≈80g (16g per tbsp).

ingredients.name: Chicken Stock
ingredients.assumptions: 150ml chicken stock (typical low-fat prepared stock density ≈1g/ml).

ingredients.name: Greek Yogurt
ingredients.assumptions: 200g full-fat Greek yogurt as given (standard nutritional profile).
